title: No integration test for CLI --operation-id cancel recovery with offset>900 pagination limit (fail-close)
description: REQ-SYNC-020 (behavioral-spec.md line 256) specifies pagination with offset<=900 for cancel subscription search. The source design doc (implementation-design-mvp.md line 174) mandates: 'offset<=900 (max 1000 items), has_more=true at offset=900 -> fail-close'. INT-SYNC-029 covers the subscribe charge search offset>900 case, but there is no corresponding INT-SYNC test for the cancel subscription search pagination limit. INT-SYNC-030 covers metadata absent + period_end mismatch but not the pagination boundary.
location: specs/verification-architecture.md lines 128-129 — INT-SYNC-029 is subscribe-only; no cancel pagination limit test
recommendation: Add an INT-SYNC test: 'CLI --operation-id cancel recovery: offset>900 with has_more=true -> fail-close'.
